Nycia Emerson    Inspired Events &amp; Designs    Nycia Emerson is the owner of Inspired Events and Designs, an Event Planning &amp; Interior Styling boutique in Austin, TX. &nbsp;She is also the founder of She Inspires, an organization that brings women together in a creative setting, to link arms and be encouraged. &nbsp;Nycia has been featured on blogs such as Style Me Pretty, Wedding Chicks and many others. &nbsp;She loves; interior design, lovely tablescapes, weddings, flowers, wine, coffee, and road trips with her husband and two boys, that include big bags of gummy bears. She believes that we are surrounded with inspiration daily, and we should grab a hold of it and let it bring us complete Joy.
